item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-4f271cfabd4a883e","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In October 2023, China’s Foreign Ministry characterized Philippine activities near Ren’ai Jiao as violations of Chinese sovereignty, rejected the South China Sea arbitration award, and said China would do what was necessary under domestic and international law to safeguard its claimed territorial and maritime interests.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","2B.6","2B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; official statement records the government position and threatened policy posture, not independently verified legal merits or operational conduct.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was issued by the Foreign Ministry under Xi Jinping’s government; personal direction by Xi is not separately established.","limitations":["The source presents China’s position and allegations rather than an independent adjudication of the dispute."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c3d7a08f16b21432","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"China enacted a comprehensive revision of its Administrative Reconsideration Law on September 1, 2023, effective January 1, 2024; the revision expanded application channels and review scope, added hearings and evidence procedures, broadened mediation, and introduced supervisory tools including interviews, notices of criticism, copied decisions, and corrective opinions.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","6B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The enactment occurred in 2023, while implementation was scheduled for 2024; observed effects during 2023 are not shown.","ruler_attribution":"The Ministry of Justice attributes the reform to decisions and instructions of Xi Jinping and the Party leadership; the source does not establish Xi’s personal role in drafting or enforcement.","limitations":["The document is an official explanatory article and reports intended institutional effects, not independent implementation outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4c7da37bb52b58ae","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Freedom House reported that China scored 9/100 on internet freedom in its 2023 assessment, remained the world’s worst environment for internet freedom for the ninth consecutive year, and experienced a one-point decline; the assessment described the Chinese Communist Party’s digital-authoritarian system as severely repressive.","question_ids":["3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report covered developments from June 2022 through May 2023 and was released in October 2023, so it substantially but not completely covers calendar 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the Chinese Communist Party regime during Xi Jinping’s rule; it does not isolate Xi’s personal decisions from broader party-state action.","limitations":["The score is an external composite assessment rather than a single event or policy outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-99d96e86c8b3085c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"As of August 1, 2026, China was not listed among the 95 signatories or 75 parties to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons; the treaty entered into force in 2021.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The status page is current to 2026 and does not establish China’s treaty status specifically at the end of 2023; it nevertheless indicates no later accession by the stated date.","ruler_attribution":"The treaty status concerns the Chinese state; Xi’s personal decision is not separately documented.","limitations":["The source does not explain China’s non-participation or establish whether any 2023 decision caused it."]},{"source_id":"SRC-342cc5d5ee566a58","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On February 24, 2023, China issued a 12-point position paper on Ukraine that called for respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, an end to hostilities, resumed negotiations, humanitarian access, civilian and prisoner-of-war protection, nuclear-plant safety, rejection of nuclear use and threats, and post-conflict reconstruction.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.8","2B.1","2B.7","2B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source records stated policy positions, not complete implementation or influence on the conflict.","ruler_attribution":"The paper was issued by China’s Foreign Ministry under Xi Jinping’s leadership; personal authorship or operational follow-through is not separately established.","limitations":["The document states proposed principles and actions but does not demonstrate compliance, mediation success, or durable settlement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b95f1ac5dc740f0d","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"China’s National Bureau of Statistics reported that December 2022 retail sales fell 1.8% year on year and full-year 2022 retail sales fell 0.2%, with catering revenue down 6.3% for the year.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The release was published in January 2023 but reports 2022 outcomes, providing baseline context rather than a 2023 result.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe China’s economy under Xi’s government but do not attribute the outcome to a specific Xi decision.","limitations":["The source covers retail activity only and cannot by itself establish overall economic welfare or policy causation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1d86e48d2cb7508a","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"China’s National Bureau of Statistics reported that 2023 total retail sales increased 7.2% year on year to 47,149.5 billion yuan; urban retail sales rose 7.1%, rural retail sales 8.0%, and online physical-goods retail sales 8.4%.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers calendar year 2023; the figures are nominal growth rates unless otherwise specified.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe an outcome under Xi’s government but do not establish that Xi personally caused the changes.","limitations":["Retail growth is not equivalent to broad-based welfare, real income growth, or equitable distribution; the source reports nominal rates."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4fecc6d50f13f24f","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"A 2023 NBER review described China’s anti-corruption campaign, begun when Xi Jinping took power in December 2012, as unprecedented in magnitude and duration and reported lasting effects on Chinese bureaucracy, firms, consumers, decision-making, and resource allocation.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.9","7B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in May 2023 and evaluates a campaign continuing through the period; it synthesizes prior research rather than providing a calendar-2023 event count.","ruler_attribution":"The paper explicitly links the campaign’s start to Xi’s assumption of power, but its findings concern the campaign and Chinese institutions rather than Xi’s personal conduct.","limitations":["The author notes that the views are his own and the review summarizes varied research; the excerpt does not establish whether anti-corruption enforcement was politically impartial."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4526e5983ecb3644","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A July 2023 Xinhua account described a military modernization program with stated milestones of achieving the centenary military-building goal by 2027, basic military modernization by 2035, and a world-class military by 2050, framed as advancing national rejuvenation.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source records announced goals and program structure, not completion or independent assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The account explicitly attributes the military strategy and roadmap to Xi Jinping and the Central Military Commission.","limitations":["The source is state media and provides no independent evaluation of costs, proportionality, or progress toward the milestones."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4526e5983ecb3644","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In 2023, China conducted the April 8–10 “Joint Sword” exercises around Taiwan, described by Xinhua as a planned response to Taiwan-related developments; the same account reported that China’s navy evacuated 940 Chinese citizens and 231 foreign nationals from Sudan between April 26 and 29.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.9","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Both events occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The military exercise and evacuation were presented as actions under Xi’s Central Military Commission and national leadership; the source does not document Xi’s individual order for either event.","limitations":["The exercise is described by official media and lacks independent assessment of necessity or escalation effects; the evacuation figure is an official operational report."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4526e5983ecb3644","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In 2023, China reported issuing Central Military Commission rules and study programs to implement the chairman-responsibility system, holding a July military-governance study session chaired by Xi, and putting a revised Conscription Work Regulation into force on May 1.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source documents formal institutional measures but not independent implementation quality.","ruler_attribution":"The source directly attributes the military-governance direction and chairman-responsibility measures to Xi Jinping and the Central Military Commission.","limitations":["The account is official state media and does not test compliance, dissent, resource adequacy, or operational results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4f71141f190e4226","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"China’s Ministry of Education reported for 2023 that the country had 498,300 schools, 291 million students, and 18.9178 million full-time teachers; preschool gross enrollment reached 91.1%, and nine-year compulsory-education retention reached 95.7%.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly covers calendar year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statistics describe national education provision under Xi’s government; they do not establish Xi’s personal causal contribution.","limitations":["The release provides aggregate national indicators and does not show regional, class, gender, disability, or minority incidence in the excerpt."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-d8808c10195eae1b","SRC-503f40d68c682889"],"batch_limitations":["The two no-first-use documents are duplicate 2024 Ministry of Foreign Affairs pages and fall outside the requested 2023 period; their substantive nuclear-policy content was not treated as a separate 2023 fact.","Several official Chinese sources state government policy or reported outcomes but do not independently establish Xi Jinping’s personal decision, implementation quality, or causal responsibility."]}
